findings.evidenceJa: あの爺さんとはこっちでカタをつける
findings.governingReading: Shirou says his side will settle matters decisively with Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English loses both collective responsibility and the final-settlement force.

findings.highlight: I haven’t put any thought into them
findings.evidenceJa: そのどれを取るべきかはまだ考えていなかった
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes several means exist but has not considered which one to choose.
findings.explanation: The English falsely says he has given none of the possibilities any thought.

findings.highlight: She may not become our ally
findings.evidenceJa: 味方……とまではいかないにしても
findings.governingReading: Before naming the Master, Shirou says only that the person may not become an ally.
findings.explanation: The English prematurely fixes the referent as female.

findings.governingReading: Zouken implanted worms in Sakura and forced her to fight.
findings.explanation: The English again collapses the invasive plurality to one worm.

findings.governingReading: Because direct victory is unavailable, Zouken will employ various schemes.
findings.explanation: The English intensifies a range of stratagems into unrestricted means.

findings.evidenceJa: アインツベルンの名を冠した
findings.governingReading: Illya was raised as a Master and bears the Einzbern name.
findings.explanation: The English uses an unsupported coronation metaphor.

findings.governingReading: Shirou must warn Illya about Zouken’s covert machinations and the unidentified shadow or something irreparable may happen.
findings.explanation: The English deletes Zouken’s covert action and specifies the uncertain irreversible outcome as fatal to Illya.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺より何倍も危険だろう
findings.governingReading: Sakura is probably many times more endangered than Shirou because she cannot resist Zouken.
findings.explanation: The English drops the magnitude of his protective calculation.

findings.highlight: a route Illya showed me with her magic
findings.evidenceJa: イリヤの魔術によって得た[ruby text=みちゆき char=2]直感
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s route is an intuition or guidance acquired through Illya’s magic.
findings.explanation: The English turns magical intuition into an ordinary route she displayed.

findings.governingReading: Shirou hears the familiar resonance of the way his name is called, evoking Saber before he identifies Rider.
findings.explanation: The English identifies familiarity in the speaker’s voice rather than the cadence of the name.

findings.highlight: with as much intimacy as she can show
findings.evidenceJa: 不器用ながらもできる限りの親しみを込めて
findings.governingReading: The remembered call was careful and carried as much affection as Saber could manage despite her awkwardness.
findings.explanation: The English omits the clumsiness central to Saber’s restrained affection.

findings.evidenceJa: あり得ない名前を口にしかける
findings.governingReading: Shirou begins to utter a name whose presence here is impossible.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the name’s impossibility into an explicit psychological wish.

findings.governingReading: Shirou is, at least for present purposes, Rider’s ally.
findings.explanation: The English changes his qualified current status into possible future alliance.

findings.highlight: It’s not that I’m putting undue importance on it
findings.evidenceJa: もったいぶってるんじゃなくて
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he is not being coy or theatrically withholding the reason.
findings.explanation: The English changes manner of disclosure into an assessment of importance.

findings.highlight: I’ve made Sakura suffer until now
findings.evidenceJa: 今まで桜一人を苦しめてきた
findings.governingReading: Until now, Sakura alone has borne the suffering.
findings.explanation: The English assigns Shirou direct causal responsibility rather than his guilty recognition of her isolation.

findings.highlight: compensate for that by making her happy
findings.evidenceJa: どんな手を使っても幸せにしてやりたい
findings.governingReading: Shirou wants to make Sakura happy by any means necessary, in proportion to her suffering.
findings.explanation: The English reduces his extreme resolve to ordinary compensation.

findings.highlight: I shall answer it to the best of my ability
findings.evidenceJa: 私にできる範囲でなら聞き届けます
findings.governingReading: Rider agrees to grant or heed the request if it lies within her ability.
findings.explanation: The English changes compliance with a request into answering it.

findings.governingReading: Shirou jokes that Rider’s attempted pronunciation yields 死蝋, “corpse wax,” amid written homophone variants.
findings.explanation: The English erases the joke’s lexical mechanism and all distinct attempted forms.

findings.evidenceJa: ライダーはわりと付き合いがいい
findings.governingReading: Despite her sharp appearance, Rider is fairly accommodating and willing to humor Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English changes being a good sport into general sociability.
